answer.book: W02846_Goldast_2: Goldast's second volume of the Monarchia S. Romani Imperii (1668), a collection of several works on papal and imperial power, each with its own heading and numbering: the Chronica of Iordanus on the translation of the Empire to the Germans, works by Gerson and Theodoric of Niem, Aeneas Sylvius, Jacobus de Paradiso, Sigismund of Austria, Gregory Heimburg, Pico della Mirandola, Lauretus, the Gallican council of Tours, the Pisan council, Philippus Decius and the Index.
